training: regressor-pretrained retained assay heads; 3 enhancers per background
schematic_note: DNA, connections and signal profiles are illustrative, not empirical predictions. Dashed branches are pretraining-only signal projections, removed during classification; 16-bp ATAC and 64-bp H3K27ac profiles cover the central 512/1536 bp respectively. Grey profile flanks are unpredicted, not zero signal. Dropout and inference calibration are omitted from the compact head schematic.
calibrated_inference: Mean forward/RC sigmoid probabilities; context-wise sigmoid on their clipped logits.
